text:
morgan: Heads up — canary rollout for routing-v2 (50/50 in console) is showing +1.8% error rate vs baseline, aggregated p=0.03. not huge but above our alert guard. can we validate the assignment? :thinking:
jas: can you paste the raw counts?
morgan: sure, running the counts now — query below:
```sql
SELECT variant, count(*) as n, SUM(error) as errs
FROM requests
WHERE experiment = 'routing-v2-canary' AND ts > '2026-03-15'
GROUP BY variant;
```
deploy-bot: Automated canary check finished: metric=error_rate, delta=+1.8%, p=0.031, threshold=0.02, status=flagged.
priya: raw counts: control n=48,600 errs=420 (0.865%), canary n=52,100 errs=548 (1.053%). not an order-of-magnitude SRM but notice canary has more EU mobile traffic.
riley: interesting — console weight says 50/50 but routing rules include a geo -> mobile override. could be heavy users hitting canary.
jas: can we check expected vs observed bucket proportions? quick chi-sq or even just ratio test.
morgan: did a quick binomial test on assignment: expected 50% -> observed canary 52.4%, chi2 p=0.0009. so assignment skew exists.
priya: assignment skew explains some of it, but error uplift still >0.7pp after reweighting for geo+platform segments. so not fully explained.
sam: what's our stopping rule here? we hit the canary end-of-day check but not the stop-traffic guard yet. current policy: pause if p<0.01 OR delta>2.5pp OR error spike on primary SLA.
riley: debate point: do we pause now and investigate more, or shrink to 10% and run stratified evaluation? shrinking buys time and reduces user impact.
jas: +1 for shrink to 10% and enable segmented telemetry (geo+device+token-size). also run blocking analysis for heavy-tail users.
morgan: I'm for shrink. I'll create a quick rollout change: routing-v2 -> 10% canary, console will still show a staged rollout.
priya: FYI, logs show stacktrace cluster NPE on EU mobile in canary only — filing a bug now.
deploy-bot: Rolling change submitted: traffic 50->10 for variant=canary. change_id=chg_20260315_17. Estimated completion 30s.
deploy-bot: Rollout change complete. current split: control 90%, canary 10%.
sam: we should also add a guard in the rollout config to auto-scale the canary down if assignment skew >3% vs expected in the first hour. file a ticket?
jas: filing ticket now: PLAT-8892 "auto-shrink guard for assignment skew + segmented telemetry". assigning to eng-platform.
morgan: thanks. we'll leave the canary at 10% and rerun the analysis after another 2k canary requests.
priya: note — if bug fix is quick we can try a targeted patch to EU mobile subset then re-run canary.
riley: ack. decision: shrink to 10%, investigate EU mobile NPE, add auto-shrink guard. will reconvene after 2k requests or earlier if error rate exceeds 2.5pp. :eyes:
jas: thanks everyone.
morgan: closing thread for now, will post updates."
